mandatoryFamilyIntegration.legacy: All families declaring nativeResume must implement adoptLegacy({context,lease,runtime,source,ensure}) using original SDK/schema/native metadata APIs. Input cwd/Home is not evidence. Confirm actual native ID, actual bound Home/cwd/scope, protocol and stable native turn/assistant-message boundary without a prompt. Codex/Claude must read native metadata without calling their create-only ensureThread. ACP/OpenCode may choose source-native ensure/read only when its actual native ID is preserved. Verify ID again after resume. Missing hook is explicitly incomplete family integration, not final rejection of valid legacy sessions. Query/reconcile unknown side effects; never redispatch.
mandatoryFamilyIntegration.tools: Family original native permission callbacks must consume the scoped runtimeHost, deny all ungranted native permissions and admit only the existing trusted PM transport. Remove t3 MCP and application instructions; preserve native environment/Home behavior and no-tool title generation. Information answers never become permission approvals.
mandatoryFamilyIntegration.fullPayload: Original readThreadSnapshot messages must hydrate final withheld text/tool/command payloads. If the original snapshot withholds details, provide readFullItem({context,lease,runtime,thread,item}) via an original typed detail API. No truncated-as-full payload or invented success.
mandatoryFamilyIntegration.bufferedPiT12: Implement adoptBuffered({context,lease,runtime,request,turn,isCurrent}) only as an original zero-prompt native drain/adopt helper with unique providerTurn identity in the same live generation. turn deliberately omits message. Original Pi adapter.ts line 2431 derives its providerTurn ID from providerThread+attemptId, while lines 2493-2505 still dispatch a prompt for user/server initiators even with pendingWake. Required source patch: a real buffered-only branch and unique native-turn correlation without replaying old root terminals. Generic empty-message startTurn is forbidden. Ended/expired generations receive a notification plus original clearIfCurrent, never reopen/retry/business scheduling.
mandatoryFamilyIntegration.secretQuestions: Original OrchestrationV2UserInputQuestion lacks a secret marker. secret_request remains an explicit nonrespondable notification. Do not infer secret semantics from question text or invent a fake shared-schema field. If an original SDK secret field is lost, submit actual source callsite evidence for parent-approved minimal optional schema extension and persistence/display nonleak regressions.
mandatoryFamilyIntegration.errorEvidence: Original structured cause code/status/reset/header evidence is flattened only for the existing PM classifier; raw native causes and headers are not exposed. Families preserve original typed failures rather than hand-parsing protocols.
